hutaomod.hu_tao.title: Hu Tao
hutaomod.hu_tao.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.\nSpend HP to unleash devastating butterfly strikes, and mark enemies with lingering Blood Blossom.\nKeyword: Blood Blossom - each time an afflicted creature takes attack damage, it takes 1 additional damage per stack; stacks decrease by 1 each turn.
hutaomod.hu_tao.goldMonologue: Gold is useful too... but coffins sell better!
hutaomod.hu_tao.eventDeathPrevention: Not yet! The boundary between life and death is mine to guard!
hutaomod.hu_tao.aromaPrinciple: "Plum blossoms bloom at the boundary between life and death."
hutaomod.hu_tao.cardsModifierDescription: __ cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
hutaomod.hu_tao.banter.alive.endTurnPing: Take your time... the butterflies will wait.
